verdict_reason: versionId computation is correct for the ticket's 7-event catalogue but silently emits versionId: 0 on never-submitted-draft NOTIFICATION_EDITED saves, an untested regression on an already-consumed, out-of-scope event type.

todos.issue: computeVersionId() only excludes NOTIFICATION_CREATED/NOTIFICATION_DELETED from the count; NOTIFICATION_EDITED (fired on every DRAFT/AMEND page save via replace(), out of this ticket's event catalogue) falls into the submission-carry-forward branch, so a draft edited before its first submission now emits versionId: 0 -- a value the schema's own semantics ('V1 on first submission') never produce. No test in the new VersionId nested class covers NOTIFICATION_EDITED.
todos.fix: Add NOTIFICATION_EDITED to NO_VERSION_ID_EVENTS (or otherwise special-case it) so a never-submitted draft omits versionId instead of emitting 0, and add a VersionId test for a NOTIFICATION_EDITED save with submissionCount 0.
